resources.string: A silent metronome you feel, not hear.
This phone can\'t vary vibration strength, so intensity adjusts how long each pulse lasts instead.

Once started, it keeps pulsing with the screen off and the phone locked. Stop it from here or from the notification. With a timer set, it stops on its own and gives three long buzzes so you know time is up. Settings changes apply instantly, even while running.
Shown while the metronome is pulsing, with a Stop button.
